notes.title: Why this game got removed from Google Play
notes.content:
This game was made in [b]2013[/b] with [b]Unity 4[/b], and employed [b]targeted ads[/b] SDK.
When [b]GDPR[/b] and other regulations took effect, that SDK was no longer compliant with [b]Google[/b]'s policies.

This resulted in removal from Google Play. [b]Drunken Wrestlers[/b] was my [b]main source of income[/b] for the longest time, and I lost it just like that.

[h3]Why I can't do anything about it[/h3]
The version of Unity this game was created with does not support building [b].apk[/b] files for minimum [b]API level[/b] required by [b]Google Play[/b] nowadays. I have been trying to upgrade this project to newer versions of Unity for years, but with [b]Unity 5[/b] they have changed something in the [b]physics engine[/b], and the game no longer worked after upgrade. The characters would just collapse instantly.
https://forum.unity.com/threads/u5-issues-with-hinge-joints.307617/#post-2005454
This issue has never been fixed and I remained in an inextricable situation.

[h3]Why Steam release[/h3]
In the months following the removal, there bacame [b]less and less traces of this game ever existing[/b]. Some people got confused as to why is there [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/667530/Drunken_Wrestlers_2/]Drunken Wrestlers 2[/url][/b] when there is no [b]Drunken Wrestlers 1[/b]. All of this have set me up to rerelease this game on [b]Steam[/b].
